entries.resolution: Feeble Glooth Horror is the feeble_glooth_horror participant; its file registers GloothHorror.
onDeath of "Feeble Glooth Horror".

Canary defect: Game.createMonster("Weakened Glooth Horror", targetMonster:getPosition(), true, true) twice reads the undefined global targetMonster, so the script errors and nothing spawns. The reference-date wiki ("When slain, the Feeble Glooth Horror will turn into 2 Weakened Glooth Horrors"; 16 Empowered Glooth Horrors in total) decides (D25): two of the next stage appear where it died. The teleport effect on each is cosmetic.
Weakened Glooth Horror is the weakened_glooth_horror participant; its file registers GloothHorror.

onDeath of the configured boss "empowered glooth horror".
checkHorror: nothing happens while a living glooth horror of any stage is within 13 tiles of (33555, 31956, 15) on that floor (the horror_arena anchor); the dying one has 0 health and does not count.

Teleporter 1949 on (33545, 31955, 15) becomes 22761 leading to (33534, 31955, 15); after 2 minutes revertTeleport turns it back into 1949 with the destination it had before (oldPos): the revert restores the original item and its attributes.
The thunder effect on the boss position is cosmetic.
Game.setStorageValue(<running flag>, 0) frees the shared arena that movements_glooth_horror.lua locks; an instance per party (D26) replaces the lock.
